column2:
a(art.)一個、每一
an(art.)一個(用於母音開頭的字前)
a lot of 許多
an hour 一小時
I have a dog and a cat.
(我有一隻狗和一隻貓。)
She eats an apple every day.
(她每天吃一顆蘋果。)

ability(n.)能力、才能
able(adj.)能夠的
unable(adj.)不能的
ability to learn 學習能力
natural ability 天賦
She has the ability to speak three languages.
(她有說三種語言的能力。)
Reading improves your ability to think.
(閱讀能提升你的思考能力。)

able(adj.)能夠的、有能力的
ability(n.)能力
unable(adj.)不能的
be able to 能夠
able student 能幹的學生
I am able to swim now.
(我現在會游泳了。)
Will you be able to come tomorrow?
(你明天能來嗎？)

about(prep./adv.)關於、大約、到處
(無詞性變化)
talk about 談論
about ten minutes 大約十分鐘
This book is about a brave girl.
(這本書是關於一個勇敢的女孩。)
It takes about ten minutes to walk there.
(走路到那裡大約要十分鐘。)

above(prep./adv./adj.)在……上方、超過、上述的
(無詞性變化)
above all 最重要的是
above average 高於平均
The bird is flying above the tree.
(鳥在樹的上方飛。)
His grades are above average.
(他的成績高於平均。)

abroad(adv.)在國外、到國外
(無詞性變化)
study abroad 出國留學
travel abroad 出國旅行
My sister wants to study abroad.
(我姊姊想出國留學。)
We travel abroad every summer.
(我們每年夏天都出國旅行。)

across(prep./adv.)橫越、在對面
cross(v.)越過
across the street 在街道對面
come across 偶然遇到
The bank is across the street.
(銀行在街道對面。)
We walked across the bridge.
(我們走過那座橋。)

act(n./v.)行為、法案、行動、表演
action(n.)行動
active(adj.)活躍的
actor(n.)演員
act quickly 迅速行動
an act of kindness 善舉
We must act now to save the earth.
(我們必須現在就行動來拯救地球。)
He acts in a school play.
(他在學校的話劇中演出。)

action(n.)行動、動作
act(v.)行動
active(adj.)活躍的
take action 採取行動
action movie 動作片
It is time to take action.
(是時候採取行動了。)
I love watching action movies.
(我很愛看動作片。)

actor(n.)演員、男演員
actress(n.)女演員
act(v.)表演
famous actor 知名演員
best actress 最佳女主角
The actor is very popular in Taiwan.
(這位演員在台灣很受歡迎。)
She wants to be an actress.
(她想當一名女演員。)

add(v.)增加、加上、補充說
addition(n.)加法、增加
add up 加總
add salt 加鹽
Please add some sugar to my tea.
(請在我的茶裡加點糖。)
If you add two and three, you get five.
(二加三等於五。)

afraid(adj.)害怕的、恐怕
(無詞性變化)
be afraid of 害怕……
I'm afraid 恐怕
My little brother is afraid of dogs.
(我弟弟很怕狗。)
I'm afraid I can't go with you.
(恐怕我不能跟你去。)

after(prep./conj./adv.)在……之後
afterward(adv.)之後
after school 放學後
look after 照顧
Let's play basketball after school.
(我們放學後去打籃球吧。)
She looks after her grandma every day.
(她每天照顧她的奶奶。)

afternoon(n.)下午
(無詞性變化)
in the afternoon 在下午
this afternoon 今天下午
We have a math test this afternoon.
(我們今天下午有數學考試。)
He takes a nap in the afternoon.
(他下午會睡個午覺。)

again(adv.)再一次、又
(無詞性變化)
again and again 一再地
once again 再一次
Please say it again.
(請再說一次。)
I hope to see you again soon.
(希望很快能再見到你。)

age(n./v.)年齡、時代、變老
aged(adj.)年老的、……歲的
at the age of 在……歲時
for ages 很久
He started playing piano at the age of five.
(他五歲時開始彈鋼琴。)
We are the same age.
(我們同年紀。)

ago(adv.)以前
(無詞性變化)
long ago 很久以前
two years ago 兩年前
I moved to Taipei two years ago.
(我兩年前搬到台北。)
Long ago, people lived in caves.
(很久以前，人們住在洞穴裡。)

agree(v.)同意、agreement(n.)協議、同意
disagree(v.)不同意
agree with 同意(某人)
reach an agreement 達成協議
I agree with you.
(我同意你的看法。)
The two sides finally reached an agreement.
(雙方終於達成協議。)

air(n.)空氣、天空
(無詞性變化)
fresh air 新鮮空氣
by air 搭飛機
Let's go outside for some fresh air.
(我們去外面呼吸新鮮空氣吧。)
The air in the city is not clean.
(城市裡的空氣不乾淨。)

airplane(n.)飛機
plane(n.)飛機
take a plane 搭飛機
paper airplane 紙飛機
The airplane is taking off now.
(飛機現在正在起飛。)
We took a plane to Japan.
(我們搭飛機去日本。)

airport(n.)機場
(無詞性變化)
at the airport 在機場
airport bus 機場巴士
My dad will pick me up at the airport.
(我爸爸會到機場接我。)
The airport is very busy today.
(機場今天非常忙碌。)

all(adj./adv./pron./n.)全部、所有、完全
(無詞性變化)
all day 整天
after all 畢竟
All my friends came to the party.
(我所有的朋友都來參加派對了。)
It rained all day.
(下了一整天的雨。)

allow(v.)允許、准許
allowance(n.)零用錢、津貼
allow sb. to 允許某人做……
not allowed 不准
My mom allows me to play games on weekends.
(我媽媽允許我週末打電動。)
Smoking is not allowed here.
(這裡禁止吸菸。)

almost(adv.)幾乎、差不多
(無詞性變化)
almost all 幾乎全部
almost never 幾乎從不
I almost missed the bus.
(我差點錯過公車。)
Dinner is almost ready.
(晚餐快準備好了。)

along(prep./adv.)沿著、一起
(無詞性變化)
along the river 沿著河
get along with 與……相處
We walked along the beach.
(我們沿著海灘散步。)
She gets along with her classmates.
(她和同學相處融洽。)

already(adv.)已經
(無詞性變化)
already done 已經完成
already late 已經遲了
I have already finished my homework.
(我已經寫完功課了。)
It is already ten o'clock.
(已經十點了。)

also(adv.)也、而且
(無詞性變化)
not only... but also 不但……而且
also known as 又稱為
I like music, and I also like sports.
(我喜歡音樂，也喜歡運動。)
She is also a good singer.
(她也是個很棒的歌手。)

although(conj.)雖然、儘管
(無詞性變化)
although it rained 雖然下了雨
although tired 雖然累
Although it was cold, we went swimming.
(雖然天氣冷，我們還是去游泳了。)
Although he is young, he is very smart.
(雖然他年紀小，但他非常聰明。)

always(adv.)總是、一直
(無詞性變化)
as always 一如往常
always remember 永遠記得
She always gets up early.
(她總是很早起床。)
I will always remember you.
(我會永遠記得你。)

am(adv.)上午、午前
AM(adv.)上午(也寫作 a.m.)
at 7 a.m. 在上午七點
a.m. and p.m. 上午和下午
School starts at 8 a.m.
(學校早上八點開始上課。)
I woke up at 6 a.m. today.
(我今天早上六點起床。)

and(conj.)和、而且、然後
(無詞性變化)
and so on 等等
both A and B A 和 B 兩者
I bought bread and milk.
(我買了麵包和牛奶。)
He came home and took a shower.
(他回到家然後洗了澡。)

angry(adj.)生氣的
anger(n.)憤怒
angrily(adv.)生氣地
get angry 生氣
be angry with 對某人生氣
My mom got angry because I was late.
(因為我遲到，媽媽生氣了。)
Don't be angry with me.
(別生我的氣。)

animal(n.)動物
(無詞性變化)
wild animal 野生動物
farm animal 家畜
The zoo has many animals.
(動物園裡有很多動物。)
Dogs are my favorite animals.
(狗是我最喜歡的動物。)

another(adj./pron.)另一個、再一個
(無詞性變化)
one another 彼此
another day 改天
Can I have another cookie?
(我可以再吃一塊餅乾嗎？)
Let's talk about it another day.
(我們改天再談吧。)

answer(n./v.)答案、回答、接(電話)
(無詞性變化)
answer the phone 接電話
the right answer 正確答案
Can you answer this question?
(你能回答這個問題嗎？)
Please answer the phone for me.
(請幫我接電話。)

ant(n.)螞蟻
(無詞性變化)
red ant 紅螞蟻
a line of ants 一排螞蟻
There are ants on the cake!
(蛋糕上有螞蟻！)
Ants work very hard together.
(螞蟻們一起努力工作。)

any(pron./adj./adv.)任何、一些
(無詞性變化)
any time 任何時候
any more 再也(不)
Do you have any questions?
(你有任何問題嗎？)
You can call me any time.
(你隨時可以打給我。)

anybody(pron.)任何人
anyone(pron.)任何人
anyone else 其他任何人
anybody here 這裡有人
Is anybody home?
(有人在家嗎？)
Don't tell anyone my secret.
(別把我的祕密告訴任何人。)

anything(pron.)任何事物
(無詞性變化)
anything else 其他任何東西
anything but 絕不
Do you need anything else?
(你還需要什麼嗎？)
I didn't eat anything this morning.
(我今天早上什麼都沒吃。)

apartment(n.)公寓
(無詞性變化)
rent an apartment 租公寓
apartment building 公寓大樓
We live in a small apartment.
(我們住在一間小公寓裡。)
He rented an apartment near school.
(他在學校附近租了一間公寓。)

appear(v.)出現、似乎
appearance(n.)出現、外表
disappear(v.)消失
appear on TV 上電視
appear to be 似乎是
A rainbow appeared after the rain.
(雨後出現了一道彩虹。)
She appears to be very tired.
(她看起來非常累。)

apple(n.)蘋果
(無詞性變化)
apple juice 蘋果汁
apple pie 蘋果派
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
(一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。)
I drink apple juice every morning.
(我每天早上喝蘋果汁。)

area(n.)地區、區域、領域
(無詞性變化)
rural area 鄉村地區
parking area 停車區
There are many shops in this area.
(這個地區有很多商店。)
Please wait in the waiting area.
(請在等候區等待。)

arm(n./v.)手臂、武裝
army(n.)軍隊
armed(adj.)武裝的
arm in arm 手挽著手
break an arm 摔斷手臂
He broke his arm playing soccer.
(他踢足球時摔斷了手臂。)
They walked arm in arm.
(他們手挽著手走路。)

around(prep./adv.)在周圍、大約、到處
(無詞性變化)
around the world 全世界
look around 四處看看
We sat around the table.
(我們圍著桌子坐。)
He traveled around the world.
(他環遊了世界。)

arrive(v.)到達、抵達
arrival(n.)到達
arrive at/in 抵達(某地)
arrive on time 準時到達
We arrived at school at seven.
(我們七點到達學校。)
The train arrived on time.
(火車準時抵達。)

art(n.)藝術、美術、技巧
artist(n.)藝術家
artistic(adj.)藝術的
work of art 藝術品
art class 美術課
Art is my favorite subject.
(美術是我最喜歡的科目。)
This painting is a great work of art.
(這幅畫是一件偉大的藝術品。)

as(conj./adv./prep.)當……時、因為、像……一樣、作為
(無詞性變化)
as... as 和……一樣
as soon as 一……就
He is as tall as his father.
(他和他爸爸一樣高。)
She works as a nurse.
(她的職業是護理師。)

ask(v.)問、請求、邀請
(無詞性變化)
ask for 要求
ask a question 提問
May I ask you a question?
(我可以問你一個問題嗎？)
He asked for my help.
(他請求我的幫忙。)

at(prep.)在(某地點、某時刻)、向
(無詞性變化)
at home 在家
at night 在晚上
I am at home now.
(我現在在家。)
Look at the stars in the sky.
(看看天上的星星。)

attack(n./v.)攻擊、(疾病)發作
attacker(n.)攻擊者
heart attack 心臟病發作
attack on 對……的攻擊
The dog attacked the cat.
(那隻狗攻擊了貓。)
My grandpa had a heart attack last year.
(我爺爺去年心臟病發作。)

aunt(n.)阿姨、姑姑、伯母、嬸嬸、舅媽
(無詞性變化)
my aunt 我的阿姨
aunt and uncle 叔叔阿姨
My aunt lives in Kaohsiung.
(我阿姨住在高雄。)
My aunt gave me a birthday gift.
(我姑姑送我一份生日禮物。)

away(adv.)離開、在遠處、不在
(無詞性變化)
go away 走開
far away 很遠
My school is far away from my home.
(我的學校離我家很遠。)
The cat ran away.
(那隻貓跑走了。)
